operation_details.item: The user's Deal A is in the negotiation stage.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning! Just finished updating the pipeline before the team sync. Feels good to have everything in one view for once.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! That sounds like a solid way to start the day. Is the pipeline view giving you the clarity you need for the week ahead?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, it really helps. I can see exactly where each deal stands at a glance. Deal A is in the negotiation stage now, so I'm keeping a close eye on that one.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Negotiation is a critical phase — nice to have it visible right alongside everything else. Are you feeling confident about how it's progressing?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty confident, but I'm not taking anything for granted. Deal B is still in the proposal stage, so that one needs some follow-up after they review the docs.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense — proposals can stall if you don't nudge at the right time. And is Deal C moving along as expected on the discovery side?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yep, Deal C is in the discovery stage, still early but promising. I like that I can toggle between stages in the pipeline view without losing track of the big picture.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a great habit — keeping the whole pipeline visible while focusing on each stage's needs. Do you find that helps your team stay aligned too?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Definitely. We review it together every week, so nobody's guessing where things stand. It keeps the conversation about data instead of gut feel.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the stage of Deal A, while keeping the stages for Deals B and C and the pipeline tracking.
